nurse.text: Fit like? Welcome to the Aberdeen Sanctuary. That's Doric for 'how are you?'. Put your team on the counter, and we'll get them sorted.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit yersel doon. We've a wee kettle, a damp biscuit and a seat with a very good view of the fog.
Aa done! Awa ye go, and mind the haar. It rolls in like a bad rumour. Ye'll nae see yer ain feet.
The Ark terminal. It's in the cupboard with the lifebelts. Aberdeen takes its emergencies seriously.

else.text: Nae bother. Come back when yer ready. We'll still be here. The fog is, too.
